review_notes: I read the whole target file and the definitions it depends on (Def_AlgebraicGeometry_DescentCharacter: baseSection, IsBaseScalar). I compared them with Mathlib's Scheme.Modules API in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Sheaf.lean (smul, smul_apply, map_comp_smul, Hom.app_smul) and looked for a global-section scalar endomorphism of a module in Mathlib. I found none, so scalarEnd and resTop look like justified, specific constructions. The finding is limited to smulLin and smulLin_apply. I did not check every use of smulLin across the repository; a grep for it returned a large listing that I did not go through. In this file, smulLin is used only through `.toAddMonoidHom`. I could not compile anything, so the replacement is untested.

findings.excerpt:
noncomputable def smulLin (r : Γ(X, ⊤)) (P : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens) : Γ(P, U) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(P, U) :=
  DistribSMul.toLinearMap Γ(X, U) Γ(P, U) (resTop r U)
findings.problem: smulLin is a local, single-use construction of "multiplication by a section on Γ(P, U)". Mathlib already provides this as `Scheme.Modules.smul`, a ring hom Γ(X, U) →+* End Γ(P, U), together with `smul_apply` and `map_comp_smul`. The file only uses smulLin through `.toAddMonoidHom`, in `AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (smulLin r P U.unop).toAddMonoidHom`. The `Γ(X, U)`-linearity it carries is never used; it only adds a type-level wrapper. The local `smulLin_apply` is a second copy of `Scheme.Modules.smul_apply`.
findings.proposed_change: Drop smulLin and smulLin_apply. In `scalarEnd`, take the components as Mathlib's `P.smul (resTop r U.unop)`, which is already a morphism in `AddCommGrpCat`. Then `scalarEnd_app` follows from `Scheme.Modules.smul_apply`. The naturality proof can use `Scheme.Modules.map_comp_smul` in place of the manual `change`/`rw` with `map_smul`.
findings.benefit: This removes a competing scalar-multiplication API and the `change`-based conversions in the naturality proof. Proofs in the file then use the same lemmas as the rest of the Mathlib scheme-module API.
